episodes.197702: A negatively tilted upper level trough approached aloft while an associated surface low's triple point passed just north of the area. Severe thunderstorms formed along the cold front and produced damaging wind gusts the night of New Year's Eve into the early morning of New Year's Day.

episodes.198101: A break from the long series of frontal systems occurred from 12/30/2024 into 1/1/2025. This allowed the Coquille River at Coquille to drop below flood stage.
episodes.200950: The Cache River at Patterson began the month of January in minor flood stage and then fell below flood stage in mid January. The site would again rise above flood stage on the last day of January.
episodes.200956: River flooding took place on the White River at Augusta entering January and lasting through the middle of the month. The river would remain in minor flood stage over this period and a crest would take place in early January.
episodes.200958: River flooding would take place on the White River at Clarendon with the river site entering minor flood stage and a crest would take place transitioning from early January into mid January.
episodes.200960: River flooding on the Black River at Black Rock was in progress to begin the month of January and remained in minor flood stage through mid-January.
episodes.200962: River flooding took place on the Black River at Pocahontas to begin early January. The flooding began in December and continued into early January. The river remained in minor flood stage and the crest occurred in December with no secondary crest occurring in January.
episodes.200970: The Ouachita River at Thatcher Lock and Dam experienced minor river flooding during early January which included a crest over this period.
episodes.200971: The Ouachita River at Camden began January in minor flood stage and would persist in minor flood stage through the early portion of the month. The river at this site would also experience a crest before returning to below flood stage later into January.

Mesonet site in Old Saybrook measured a 51 knot wind gust.
The Cache River at Patterson began the month of January in minor flood stage and remained in minor flood stage over this period into mid-January and did not encounter a crest within this period.

River flooding took place on the White River at Augusta from the beginning of January through the middle of the month. A crest would take place at this site on 1/2/2025 at 0100 LST of 31.63 feet in minor flood stage.

River flooding on the White River at Clarendon would take place from early into mid January. The river would remain in minor flood stage and a crest would take place on 1/10/2025 at 0700 LST of 27.38 feet.
River flooding on the Black River at Black Rock would begin entering January and remain in minor flood stage through the middle of January. No crest would occur in the month of January.

River flooding on the Black River at Pocahontas took place to begin the month of January. The river flooding at this site continued from December into January with the crest in minor flood stage taking place in December.

The Ouachita River at Thatcher Lock and Dam did begin January already in minor flood stage and continue into the first part of the month above flood stage. The site would experience a crest on 1/3/2025 at 2200 LST of 82.12 feet.

The Ouachita River at Camden began the month of January in minor flood stage. The river at this site would experience a crest on 1/1/2025 at 1430 LST of 28.36 feet. The river at this site would fall below minor flood stage a few days later.
The Coquille River at Coquille began the month in minor flood stage at 22.45 ft. The river steadily dropped during 01/01/2025, and fell below minor flood stage of 21.0 ft. at 01/1430 PST.
